vendors.title: Vendor Register
vendors.subtitle: All vendors the system has seen in invoices, with a risk profile based on screening history. Click a note to edit it.
vendors.loading_error: Could not load vendors. Check that the backend is running.
vendors.empty_body: Vendors are registered automatically as invoices are processed.

vat_mismatch.title: VAT Mismatch
vat_mismatch.subtitle: Invoices where sender and receiver countries differ but VAT is still registered. Exports should normally be zero-rated — follow these up with accounting or the vendor.
vat_mismatch.loading_error: Could not load VAT mismatches. Check that the backend is running.
vat_mismatch.empty_body: All scanned invoices have consistent VAT registration.

export_control.title: Export Control — Lists I/II
export_control.subtitle: Invoices whose line items may be listed under DEKSA's List I (military goods) or List II (dual-use items). Such exports may require a licence and a self-assessment against the list.
export_control.disclaimer: Decision support, not a legal determination. Final control status is decided by the exporter's technical self-assessment against the list and DEKSA's review — technical parameters cannot be read from an invoice alone.
export_control.loading_error: Could not load export control data. Check that the backend is running.
export_control.empty_body: None of the scanned invoices match List I or II.

export_control_ref.title: Export Control — lookup and reference list
export_control_ref.subtitle: Look up an ECCN/ML number or browse the imported Lists I/II.
export_control_ref.lookup_hint: Enter an ECCN or ML number to see which control list and category it belongs to.
export_control_ref.not_recognized: "{{code}}" is not a recognized control number (expected e.g. 6A001 or ML10).
export_control_ref.backfill_hint: Compute export control status for invoices screened before this feature existed, so they appear in the worklist. Admin only.
export_control_ref.backfill_error: Backfill failed. Check that you are admin and the backend is running.
export_control_ref.not_imported: The full list has not been imported yet. Run the import script (--seed for baseline, --excel for the full EU list) to populate the reference list.
export_control_ref.browse_error: Could not load the reference list.

catch_all.title: Catch-all — end-user
catch_all.subtitle: The third leg of export control: invoices where the end-user, end-use or diversion risk may trigger a licence requirement — even for goods not on the control lists.
catch_all.disclaimer: Decision support, not a legal determination. Catch-all control requires the exporter's self-assessment and often an end-user statement.
catch_all.loading_error: Could not load catch-all data. Check that the backend is running.
catch_all.empty_body: None of the scanned invoices have catch-all signals.

control_effectiveness.title: Control Deviations
control_effectiveness.subtitle: Invoices approved despite elevated compliance risk. Repeated deviations for the same vendor may indicate a control has effectively been bypassed.
control_effectiveness.loading_error: Could not load control deviations. Check that the backend is running.
control_effectiveness.empty_body: Deviations are recorded automatically when an invoice with a yellow/red score is approved.

regulatory_radar.title: Regulatory Radar
regulatory_radar.subtitle: Real-time updates from OFAC, EUR-Lex, HM Treasury and the UN Security Council. Click «Refresh» to fetch the latest changes.
regulatory_radar.loading_error: Could not load alerts. Check that the backend is running.
regulatory_radar.empty_body: Click «Refresh feeds» to fetch the latest regulatory updates.

list_admin.title: List Administration
list_admin.subtitle: Status and manual synchronisation of DEKSA Lists I/II and the Embargo list. The system checks automatically on the first Monday of each month.
list_admin.schedule_body: The system automatically checks whether the lists have been updated on the first Monday of each month at 03:15 (control lists) and 03:45 (embargo). All users are notified when a new version is available.
